---
title: "Social Programme"
---

On Tuesday evening, 22 September 2026, the social event takes place at the **Riegele Wirtshaus**,
the brewery tavern of Brauhaus Riegele in the centre of Augsburg. It starts at 18:30. See the
[Programme](program.qmd) for the full schedule of the day.

## Address
[Riegele Wirtshaus](https://www.riegele-wirtshaus.de/)\
Frölichstraße 26\
86150 Augsburg\
Germany

## Getting there
The programme of the day ends at 18:00 and the evening event starts at 18:30, so we will head to the restaurant directly after the last session.

We will leave from the workshop venue as a group at
about **18:00**. From the venue, take tram line
**3** towards *Augsburg Hauptbahnhof* from the stop **Innovationspark/LfU** (about a 3-minute walk
east of Building W) and stay on it to the terminus **Augsburg Hauptbahnhof**. From there the
Wirtshaus is roughly 250 m away, a three-minute walk.

Please buy your own tram ticket, either in the DB Navigator app or at a ticket counter (Ticketschalter). The ticket is the only thing you will need to pay for yourself. Everything else is covered, though.


## Brewery tour

The evening will open at 18:30 with a guided tour of the Riegele brewery,
followed by dinner at the Wirtshaus. [Brauhaus Riegele](https://www.riegele.de/) traces its roots
back to the brewery *Zum Goldenen Ross*, first documented in 1386, and has been run by the Riegele
family since 1884.
